name: Forum Compliance Review
description: The compliance decision that moves a forum's status, kept as its own record so that a history of compliance decisions exists (02-data-model.md §6.6). Only a compliance role may create one; recording it is what changes the forum.

fields.label: Triggered By Fields
fields.description: The watched fields whose change fired this review, as recorded at the time.

fields.label: Decision
fields.options:
Compliant
Non-Compliant
Not Applicable
Returned To Creator
fields.description: A label. The flags below say what it means; the forum status it produces is a configured mapping, read and written, never compared.

fields.label: Requires Statement
fields.description: Set by the decision that returns the forum to its creator, which cannot be recorded without questions.

fields.label: Resulting Forum Status
fields.description: The forum status this decision produced, copied at the time. Stored so the history is readable without re-deriving it.

fields.label: Attestation Task
fields.description: Set for the annual dual-signed owner and compliance review.
